changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwwaseelitemmapping AS SELECT wim.id, wim.item_type, wim.source_id, wim.item_code, wim.item_name, wim.sbs_catalog_id, wim.is_active, wim.notes, wim.created_date, wim.created_by, wim.last_modified_by, wim.last_modified_date FROM public.waseel_item_mapping wim;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwwaseelitemmapping TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwwaseelitemmapping FROM report_user;
